rationale: Pinned Origin compares every later frame with frame zero as well as its predecessor. A single background-corrupted first frame can therefore affect the entire score. Match middle/last single-frame controls to separate first-anchor effects from edit count. Reuse the 2x intermediate dose from the declared ladder; no new severity sweep or selection of bases.
analytic_rationale: For an ideal two-state feature sequence with cosine r, T=16 and K=4 opening edits reduce Origin by 13*(1-r)/30; a single first-frame edit gives 16*(1-r)/30. This is a mechanism model, not measured feature equality or a promised result.
claim_limit: Further mechanism diagnosis on already exposed follow-up videos. Preserves the original quarter-window results and all negative findings; cannot retroactively make the quarter-window target pass. Not an untouched confirmation set.
